# OpenDJI PC bridge

`OpenDJI.py` is the exact PC-side bridge module used by the ATLAS workstation
for the `best 1 live lap` snapshot. Its SHA-256 is recorded in the restore
manifest.

The Android MSDKRemote application is a separate deployment. It must be built
or supplied separately with the operator's own DJI developer key. No developer
key, Android secrets file, or key-bearing APK is stored in this repository.
